integrity: Exact rank-conditioned combinatorial derivation and Vandermonde polynomial-identity proof. Companion standard-library checker passed 954 assertions, including enumeration of 46,224 permutations. This is a self-review only, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations and consecutive length-four patterns only; no independence theorem, general weighted law, higher-pattern classification, or historical priority proof. Covariances decay on the order of 1/n.
title: Exact finite-sample fixed-point dependence for all consecutive four-patterns
